Class SimpleAliasRegistry

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.core.SimpleAliasRegistry
All Implemented Interfaces:
AliasRegistry
Direct Known Subclasses:
DefaultSingletonBeanRegistry, SimpleBeanDefinitionRegistry
public class SimpleAliasRegistry extends Object implements AliasRegistry
Simple implementation of the AliasRegistry interface.

作为 `BeanDefinitionRegistry` 实现的基类。

Since:
2.5.2
Author:
Juergen Hoeller, Qimiao Chen, Sam Brannen

    • resolveAliases

      public void resolveAliases(StringValueResolver valueResolver)
      Resolve all alias target names and aliases registered in this registry, applying the given StringValueResolver to them.

      值解析器例如可以解析目标 Bean 名称中的占位符，甚至别名名称中的占位符。

      Parameters:
      valueResolver - 要应用的 StringValueResolver

    • checkForAliasCircle

      protected void checkForAliasCircle(String name, String alias)
      检查给定名称是否已在相反方向作为别名指向给定的别名，从而提前捕获循环引用并抛出相应的 `IllegalStateException`。
      Parameters:
      name - 候选人姓名
      alias - 候选别名
